resources.string: Reads local phone contacts and syncs them to your Strapi backend.
Verify your phone number first. After verification, we will create your user profile and continue to the next page.
Enter phone in international format, for example +60123456789.
You can request an OTP now.
You can request another OTP in %1$dm %2$ds.
Please upload your identification card photo before continuing.
Contacts and gallery permissions are required
Status: Phone verified. Opening the next page...
Please enter a valid email address
Missing verified user session. Please verify your phone again.
Status: APP_API_KEY is missing. Set APP_API_KEY in Gradle or environment before building.
APP_API_KEY is missing. Please configure it before building the app.
Status: Syncing contacts and uploading image...
Status: Contacts synced. Uploading selected image...
Status: Selected image uploaded. Uploading gallery images...
Status: Completed. Contacts uploaded with %1$d created, %2$d updated. Image: %3$s. Gallery: %4$d/%5$d uploaded, %6$d failed. First error: %7$s

Full photo access is recommended for gallery upload. If you continue with limited access, the app can only upload photos currently exposed by your device permission setting.
